entities.summary: Christopher Ralph Perez is an American former professional baseball pitcher. He pitched collegiately for the University of Miami, and was selected by the St. Louis Cardinals in the first round of the 2006 Major League Baseball draft. Perez also played for the Cleveland Indians and Los Angeles Dodgers.
